name: IC Power Linear Regulator — LDO — VSSOP
description: Surface-mount low dropout (LDO) linear power regulator IC cluster utilizing VSSOP-8 packaging with 3x3mm body size and 0.65mm pitch.
selection_hints: Select for surface-mount LDO linear power regulator applications requiring a VSSOP package.
Confirm board footprint matches the VSSOP-8_3x3mm_P0.65mm land pattern.
Choose between available Tier A symbols such as LP2951-5.0_VSSOP and LP3982IMM-ADJ.
avoid_when: Do not use if the PCB layout requires through-hole or non-VSSOP packaging.
Avoid when a switching regulator or non-LDO power topology is needed.
Do not use if the board design requires a footprint other than VSSOP-8_3x3mm_P0.65mm.
